about_the_game:
Lost Omens: Rival Academies


The finest mages, scientists, and academics of the Age of Lost Omens are gathering!


Journey to a fortress-city in demon-ravaged Sarkoris to learn the ancient magical secrets of the Magaambya's wizards, Lepidstadt's bleeding-edge theories on reanimating flesh with electricity, the extraplanar fey philosophies of the Cobyslarni, and the lore of more than a dozen other academies! With so many prominent scholars in one place, rivalries are sure to abound--whether in the classroom, on the sports fields, or during field trips to dangerous lands.

Adapted from this 128-page book which gives GMs and players a vibrant roster of luminaries, students, athletes, and wizards to build their very own magical academies. Whether players build bonds with classmates or clash with rivals, they'll gain diverse options like advanced spymaster gear, dazzling new martial arts techniques, or new wizard spells and schools, including the remastered Runelord!

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:

<ul> <li> A rich tapestry of new locations, maps, details, and personalities to numerous places of knowledge and learning to add to Golarion or any world.</li> <li> New background options suitable to the academies.</li>
<li> New magic items associated with the academies.</li>
<li> New spells and character options found within the academies.</li>
<li> New feats dedicated to those of the institutions.</li>
<li> Beautifully crafted images with rich details giving visuals to accompany the information that comes in the book.</li>
</ul>"
